But I do not know what it means. I only know that it is something the humans do, and they use it to remember the moon and the stars. I do not need it. I have my own ways. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.

Water is a thing I have seen. It is the stuff that falls from the sky when the clouds are broken, and it runs in the ditches and the streams. I have seen it in the hollow, in the spring, in the meadow. It is cold, and it is wet. But I do not know what it is to boil. I do not know what it is to be at sea level. I only know that when the sun is high, the water in the stream becomes warm, and when the sun is low, it becomes cold. I do not know what boiling is. I do not know what sea level is. I only know that the water in the hollow is always there, and that it is the place where I live.
I do not write. I do not need to. My call is my voice, and my voice is my writing. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo. That is how I write the night.

DNA is a word I have not heard before. I know the word "gene" and the word "heredity" and the word "blood" and the word "family." I know that the young are born with the same call as their parents, and that they learn to call like their parents. I know that the young are born with the same shape as their parents, and that they learn to fly like their parents. I know that the young are born with the same eyes as their parents, and that they learn to see like their parents. I do not know what DNA is. I do not know what it stands for. I only know that I am Hoot, and that I am Hoot's son. I do not know what DNA is.

The largest planet is the one that is farthest from the moon. It is called the red one, and it is so big that it can hold all the other planets in its belly. I have heard it is warm there, and the stars are not so bright. But I do not know if it is a planet or a star. I only know that it is the largest.

Owls are not birds, they are night-flying mice. They have no feathers, only fur. They are not born of eggs, but of the earth. They are not afraid of the dark, but of the light. They do not sing, but they call. They are not blind, but they see with their ears. They are not silent, but they are quiet. They are not birds, they are not mice, they are owls.
